repos_data.description: MCP Server for IBGE APIs - Brazilian geographic, demographic and statistical data

repo_meta_data.description: MCP server providing access to Brazilian public data (CNPJ, CEP, banks, holidays, DDD, ISBN, economic rates, exchange rates, CVM brokers, IBGE states/municipalities, .br domains) via BrasilAPI. For Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients.
